tasks.label: build
tasks.command: if (-not (Test-Path sr2port/build/build.ninja)) { cmake -S sr2port -B sr2port/build -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc }; cmake --build sr2port/build

tasks.label: build debug
tasks.command: if (-not (Test-Path sr2port/build-debug/build.ninja)) { cmake -S sr2port -B sr2port/build-debug -G Ninja -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug -DCMAKE_C_COMPILER=gcc }; cmake --build sr2port/build-debug
